trace.cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(d:Document) WHERE p.position IN ['Frontcourt', 'Backcourt'] AND CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) = 0 AND CAST(p.draft_year AS INT64) > 2014 AND CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) <> 2 RETURN p.position AS col1, MAX(CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64)) AS col2

MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document) WHERE CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) = 0 AND CAST(p.draft_year AS INT64) > 2014 AND p.position IS NOT NULL WITH CASE WHEN p.position IN ['Center', 'Forward', 'Power Forward', 'Small Forward', 'Frontcourt'] THEN 'Frontcourt' WHEN p.position IN ['Guard', 'Point Guard', 'Shooting Guard', 'Backcourt'] THEN 'Backcourt' ELSE p.position END AS position, CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64) AS mvp RETURN position AS col1, MAX(mvp) AS col2
